_comment: How a blizzard climbs the tiers, dial by dial (design 5.0, 5.2).
Difficulty you can answer: light stops the snow settling and leather stops the freezing -- both
vanilla's own rules. Four dials: `often` (how often a storm comes), `long` (how long each lasts),
`visibility` (how close the whiteout closes in, and how hard the snow drifts) and `frostbite` (how fast
the cold gets into anyone out in it). Harmful throughout: any step brings a whole blizzard, which bites.
Leans cold, and never shares an Age with an inferno (Jonah, 2026-10-12).
